title: Small but Mighty: New Benchmarks for Split and Rephrase
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical NLP task of text simplification ('Split and Rephrase'). It introduces and evaluates new benchmark datasets created from Wikipedia articles and legal documents. The evaluation criteria are purely linguistic, such as grammaticality, sensicality, and preservation of factual information. The paper does not contain any component related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
